useCase: Detecting physically impossible 反射s in AI生成的 images, especially in eyes and glossy surfaces
mechanism: 分析 specular highlights and 反射s in eyes, glasses, metallic surfaces, and water for physical consistency. 检查 that 反射 geometry matches the scene's light source positions and object arrangements. AI models frequently generate physically impossible 反射s that violate optical laws.
accuracy: 中等 - 70-82% on images with visible reflective surfaces
name: 反射一致性分析
source: O'Brien & Farid (2012) - Exposing Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Reflections, ACM TOMM
algorithm: Specular Highlight Analysis + Reflection Symmetry Check
parameters: Detection: specular highlight segmentation, Eye 反射: corneal 反射 分析, Surface: BRDF consistency check, Symmetry: bilateral 反射 matching
description: 检查 反射s in eyes, glasses, and surfaces for physical 准确度. AI models frequently generate physically impossible or inconsistent 反射s.

references.title: O'Brien, J.F. & Farid, H. (2012). Exposing Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Reflections. ACM TOMM.
Hu, S. et al. (2021). Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights. ICASSP.

strengths:
• Based on physical optics laws
• Very effective for face/portrait 分析
• Eye 反射s are strong 真实性 indicators
• 检测 subtle physical impossibilities
limitations:
• Requires visible reflective surfaces
• Low-分辨率 images reduce 检测 ability
• Complex scenes with multiple 反射s are challenging
• Not applicable to matte/diffuse surfaces
